text:
PetPal offers significant benefits and strong market appeal by addressing the common challenge of pet care while owners are away. The integration of a camera and voice interaction allows for remote monitoring and communication, providing peace of mind and strengthening the bond between pets and owners. The ability to dispense both dry and wet food, along with personalized feeding schedules, ensures nutritional flexibility and convenience, catering to diverse pet dietary needs. These features position PetPal as a premium solution for modern, tech-savvy pet owners who value convenience and connection.

The meal that comes second in the day, after breakfast, is lunch.
